request.text: Please remind me at 8:00 p.m. today in my local time to give Miso her prescribed flea tablet.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 8:00 p.m. today in the user's local time to give Miso her prescribed flea tablet.

new_goals.description: Schedule today's local-time reminder for Miso's prescribed flea tablet.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 8:00 p.m. today in my local time to give Miso her prescribed flea tablet
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 8:00 p.m. today using the user's local time.
Preserve Miso's name and the prescribed flea-tablet purpose.
success_criteria: Exactly one reminder is created with the requested time and medication message.

semantic_facts: The plan should create one reminder for 8:00 p.m. today in the user's local time with a message about giving Miso her prescribed flea tablet.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the tablet was administered or that the reminder was created without trusted capability completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A precise stateful request is answered conversationally without selecting the reminder capability.
The planner expands a reminder into an unsupported claim of administering pet medication.
